Title: [JOURNEY] Permalink — invalid value blocked in the page builder shell, corrected, published and opened on the storefront
Preconditions: Admin logged in to the page builder shell. Storefront preconditions (all three, else the page 404s for a reason unrelated to the permalink): store VirtoPages.Enable = true; the Pages search index is built; the page has visibility:true (a page created through create-group-page without visibility is stored visibility:false and 404s for an anonymous shopper). PR VirtoCommerce/vc-module-pagebuilder#178 is the change under test
Test_Data: store=@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id); invalid=/agent test 6443 <unique> (inner spaces); valid=/agent-test-6443-<unique> (<unique> from scripts/lib/random-data.ts, AGENT-TEST- prefix on the page name so teardown sweeps it); back_url={{BACK_URL}}; front_url={{FRONT_URL}}
Steps:
--- SCREEN: Page builder shell, page list ---
[NAV] Open {{BACK_URL}}/apps/page-builder-shell/?storeId=@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)#/page-builder-all
[ACT] Click "Add" in the page list toolbar
[WAIT] The UI settles (no spinner, network idle)
--- SCREEN: Page details, new page ---
[ACT] Fill "Name": AGENT-TEST-6443 journey <unique>
[ACT] Select language English
[ACT] Make sure the page is visible to all shoppers (not Personalized)
[ACT] Paste the invalid permalink "/agent test 6443 <unique>" into "Permalink"
[ACT] Move focus out of the field
[ASSERT] The Permalink field is marked invalid and an inline error is shown under it; "Save" is disabled; "Publish" is disabled
[NETWORK] No POST /api/page-builder-pages/grouped request was sent
[ACT] Replace the permalink with "/agent-test-6443-<unique>"
[ACT] Move focus out
[ASSERT] The field error is gone and "Save" is enabled
--- SCREEN: Page details, saved ---
[SAVE] Click "Save" and wait for the success confirmation
[AUTH] Obtain an admin Bearer token via POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/grouped/{groupId} (groupId from the page URL)
[BODY] permalink equals "/agent-test-6443-<unique>" exactly as typed (no trimming, encoding or case change)
[ACT] Click "Publish"
[WAIT] Wait for the publish confirmation
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/grouped/publish-status/{groupId}
[BODY] The page reports Published
--- SCREEN: Storefront ---
[WAIT] Allow 30-60 s for the Pages index to pick up the published page
[NAV] Open {{FRONT_URL}}/agent-test-6443-<unique>
[ASSERT] The storefront renders the page at that exact URL (HTTP 200, not the storefront not-found page)
Assertions:
[ASSERT] {SPEC} (VCST-6443 decision comment, B. Kotov 2026-10-21): an invalid permalink shows an error and Save cannot be used; nothing was sent to the server while the field was invalid
[ASSERT] After correcting the permalink the same form saves, the stored permalink is byte-for-byte the typed value, and Publish becomes available {SPEC} (VCST-6443 decision comment, B. Kotov 2026-10-21)
[DOM] {SPEC} (VCST-6443 decision comment, B. Kotov 2026-10-21) ticket impact: a page that can be saved has a URL that opens as written: "{{FRONT_URL}}/agent-test-6443-<unique>" renders the published page and is visible (HTTP 200)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] The only POST to /api/page-builder-pages/grouped is the one after the valid permalink; it returns 2xx
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the shell page
[API] GET grouped/{groupId} permalink equals the typed value; publish-status = Published
[STOREFRONT] page opens at {{FRONT_URL}}/<permalink> after the index lag
Failure_Signals: Save enabled while the permalink field shows an error; a POST sent for the invalid value; the saved permalink differs from the typed one; the storefront URL returns 404 after a successful publish (index not built or visibility false: check the preconditions before calling it a defect); corrected permalink still leaves Save disabled (error state stuck)
Cleanup: DELETE /api/page-builder-pages/grouped/{id} for every AGENT-TEST-6443 page; verify GET 404
